name: courir.be
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 2 pages have no title.
lesson: Give every page a unique title of about 60 characters: the page first, the site second.
summary: www.courir.be scores 47 out of 100 (F). 14 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 34 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 250 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /fr_BE/home, /fr_BE/c/promotions-en-cours/, /fr_BE/c/decouvrir-veja/, /fr_BE/p/courir-e-carte-cadeau-courir-1511536.html and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 2 pages have no title
fix.fix: Give every page a unique title of about 30 to 60 characters.

fix.title: Certain ARIA roles must contain particular children
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /fr_BE/home, /fr_BE/c/promotions-en-cours/, /fr_BE/c/decouvrir-veja/, for example .nav. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Select element must have an accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /fr_BE/home, /fr_BE/c/promotions-en-cours/, /fr_BE/c/decouvrir-veja/, for example #select-language-FRANCE. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Meta Pixel (2 requests), and cookies uuid on cquotient.com.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
Large images are served as WebP, AVIF or SVG
Every page has a meta description
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
